sentences.japanese: 君は私の知っている中で憎たらしいほど機知に富んだ人だよ。
sentences.english: You are the wickedest witty person I know.

sentences.japanese: 恐いもの知らずのその男は憎しみと軽蔑の目でやくざをちらりと見た。
sentences.english: The bold man glanced at the gangster with hatred and contempt.

sentences.japanese: 委員会の全ての委員がお互いに憎みあっている。
sentences.english: All the members of the committee hate one another.

sentences.japanese: 愛情と憎しみは正反対の感情だ。
sentences.english: Love and hate are opposite emotions.

sentences.japanese: われわれは権力を憎むが法と秩序の必要は認める。
sentences.english: While we hate force, we recognize the need for law and order.
